about: What can be bought, and where (docs/design/11-items.md). Shared by the server (server/content/items.go), which sells and keeps what each character owns, and the game (src/game/), which shows the shops and what a player has. An item is bought once; grants are capabilities (archetypes.json) the owner has from then on. Prices are whole xu, shown as đồng (1 xu = 1 đồng); big things (phones, bikes) have game prices, small things real ones (docs/design/10-story.md, section 11). Of several phones, the one in hand is the last owned in this file's order. Ids are stable: characters store them.

about.vi: Cục gạch huyền thoại: gọi điện, nhắn tin, pin xài cả tuần. Không có Crab, không có camera.
about.en: The legendary brick: calls, texts, and a battery that lasts all week. No Crab, no camera.

about.vi: Đời mới hơn, chạy mượt hơn: đủ mọi ứng dụng.
